suleyman.name: Gazi Mustafa Kemal

base.name: Commander-in-Chief
base.text: When the Session ends, swap a Minister for an eligible player, even under a Vote of Confidence. They draw 1 Intrigue card.

suleyman.flavor: Sovereignty is the nation's, without condition.

hurrem.name: Halide Edib

base.name: Anatolian Agency
base.text: At the Verdict, you choose which Minister it falls on, instead of the Gazi.

favor.name: Pen and Rifle
favor.text: In one wave, play two cards instead of one.

hurrem.flavor: Orator at Sultanahmet, corporal at the front.

ibrahim.name: Fevzi Pasha

base.name: Council Chair
base.text: This crisis, you appoint both Ministers instead of the Gazi. You may appoint yourself.

favor.name: Marshal
favor.text: From now on, gain 1 Standing whenever a Victory is played while you are a Minister.

ibrahim.flavor: Chair of the Council, then Marshal.

sahsultan.name: Kâzım Karabekir Pasha

base.name: Eastern Front
base.text: On your turn to object, object for free and choose the replacement. It counts as your Objection this crisis.

favor.name: Fortress of Kars
favor.text: Name a player: next crisis they can't become a Minister by any route.

sahsultan.flavor: He took Kars, and told Ankara his mind.

mustafa.name: İsmet Pasha

base.name: Second Man
base.text: When the Session ends, before Commander-in-Chief, take a Minister's seat if eligible, even under a Vote of Confidence.

favor.name: Lausanne
favor.text: Whoever objects to you gives you the Standing they paid.

mustafa.flavor: He held İnönü, then the table at Lausanne.

base.name: Quarantine
base.text: Before the Session, pick a player: this crisis Intrigue can't unseat them, and they lose no Standing.

favor.name: Diagnosis
favor.text: Pick two players other than the Gazi and you. Secretly learn if they share a side.

rustem.name: Celal Bey

base.name: Çankaya
base.text: Before the Gazi appoints, talk with him alone for one minute.

favor.name: Galip Hoca
favor.text: When a wave flips, move one Intrigue card played on you to another player.

rustem.flavor: In the Aegean he went by Galip Hoca.

base.name: Hamidiye
base.text: Take 1 random Intrigue card from another player's hand, then discard to your limit.

favor.name: Ship's Log
favor.text: After the Telegram step, secretly see what the First Minister discarded.

gritti.name: Franklin-Bouillon

base.name: Accord
base.text: Name a player. The next time they gain Standing, you gain 1 too.

favor.name: Diplomatic Pouch
favor.text: Secretly look at the top 3 Telegram cards. You may put one on the bottom.

gritti.flavor: Came to Ankara twice; left with a treaty.

base.name: Resignation
base.text: At Appoint, before Objections, give your Minister seat to an eligible player. Gain 1 Standing; don't draw.

favor.name: Sun Never Sets
favor.text: Your Intrigue cards count as cards of an open field.

tahmasp.name: Reza Khan

base.name: Frontier
base.text: When the Crisis card flips, choose this crisis's field: Floor, Backroom or Ankara.

favor.name: Coup
favor.text: Everyone, you included, keeps 1 Intrigue card of their choice and discards the rest.

tahmasp.flavor: Tehran's Minister of War, soon to be Shah.

daye.name: Nezihe Muhiddin
daye.text: Play an Intrigue card as Group Decision. You can't choose yourself.
daye.flavor: She founded a party before women could vote.

bali.name: Refet Pasha
bali.text: Play an Intrigue card as Vote of Confidence.
bali.flavor: Ankara's man in Istanbul; whoever he backs stays put.

ayas.name: Salih Bey
ayas.text: Play an Intrigue card as Appointment.
ayas.flavor: Childhood friend; first to hear who goes.

matrakci.name: Kara Fatma
matrakci.text: Play an Intrigue card as Tail.
matrakci.flavor: She watched what lay behind the enemy's lines.

sumbul.name: Ali Fuat Pasha
sumbul.text: Play an Intrigue card as Immunity. You choose its field.
sumbul.flavor: Envoy in Moscow, deputy in Ankara.

nigar.name: Hüsamettin Bey
nigar.text: Play an Intrigue card as Telegraph Office.
nigar.flavor: Ran Ankara's secret network in occupied Istanbul.

ebussuud.name: Tevfik Rüştü Bey
ebussuud.text: Play an Intrigue card as Inquiry.
ebussuud.flavor: Doctor and deputy; he reads the discarded papers too.

gulsah.name: Sedat Simavi
gulsah.text: Play an Intrigue card as Smear.
gulsah.flavor: Founder of the satirical Diken; one line cuts anyone down.

seker.name: Safiye Ali
seker.text: Play an Intrigue card as Inoculation.
seker.flavor: Turkey's first woman doctor; she treats anyone hurt.

gulfem.name: Mehmet Akif
gulfem.text: Play an Intrigue card as Surety.
gulfem.flavor: Poet of the anthem; he put his word beside Ankara's.

iskender.name: Ferid Bey
iskender.text: Play an Intrigue card as Budget.
iskender.flavor: The first Minister of Finance, with an empty treasury.

firuze.name: Celal Nuri
firuze.text: Play an Intrigue card as Headline.
firuze.flavor: Journalist and deputy; he knows who makes the front page.

gulaga.name: Ahmet Ağaoğlu
gulaga.text: Play an Intrigue card as Censor.
gulaga.flavor: Director of the Press; every line passes his desk.

lokman.name: Fethi Bey
lokman.text: Play an Intrigue card as Switchboard.
lokman.flavor: Minister of the Interior; ask him who called whom.

akil-hocasi.name: Immunity
akil-hocasi.text: For this crisis, cancels the other Intrigue cards of its field placed on this player.
akil-hocasi.flavor: What's said at the rostrum stays there.

muhur.name: Vote of Confidence
muhur.text: Place on a Minister. Intrigue cards can't replace them this crisis; Commander-in-Chief still can.
muhur.flavor: With the Assembly behind you, the seat holds.

valide.name: Group Decision
valide.text: Place on a Minister. Replace them with an eligible player, yourself included. The new player takes the same seat.
valide.flavor: Decided in the group before the floor.

azil.name: Appointment
azil.text: Place on a Minister. The Gazi replaces them with an eligible player, who takes the same seat.

casus.name: Tail
casus.text: When the Session ends, secretly see every Intrigue card this player played this crisis, and on whom.
casus.flavor: In Ulus every step has a shadow.

muhurlu-evrak.name: Telegraph Office
muhurlu-evrak.text: Secretly look at the top 3 Telegram cards and put them back in the same order.
muhurlu-evrak.flavor: News reaches the clerk before its owner.

saray-tabibi.name: Inoculation
saray-tabibi.text: This player loses no Standing this crisis, even at the Verdict.
saray-tabibi.flavor: There is a vaccine for gossip too.

iftira.name: Smear
iftira.flavor: A column, a name, a stain.

kefalet.name: Surety
kefalet.text: Place on a Minister. If they still hold a seat at the Telegram step: you gain 1 Standing on a Victory, lose 1 on a Defeat.
kefalet.flavor: Whoever stands surety signs the note too.

teftis.name: Inquiry
teftis.text: Place on a Minister. After the Telegram step, secretly look at the card or cards that Minister discarded.
teftis.flavor: The committee reads every paper, even the bin.

defterdar.name: Budget
defterdar.text: Place on the First Minister. If still First Minister at the Telegram step, they draw 4 instead of 3 and discard 2.
defterdar.flavor: Whoever writes the budget knows what to cut.

nobet.name: Switchboard
nobet.text: When the Session ends, pick one card others played on this player this crisis; secretly learn who played it.
nobet.flavor: The switchboard knows who placed the call.

nazar.name: Headline
nazar.text: Place on a Minister. If this crisis's Verdict falls on them, it gives or takes 2 Standing instead of 1.
nazar.flavor: A headline makes a name or breaks it.

sukut.name: Censor
sukut.text: This player can't play an Intrigue card in the next wave.
sukut.flavor: The column comes out blank; readers understand.

divanda-nufuz.name: Bring Down a Minister
divanda-nufuz.text: Remove a Minister from their seat with an Intrigue card.
divanda-nufuz.flavor: A Minister sits by one vote and falls by one.

suphe.name: Scapegoat
suphe.text: Be a Minister when a Defeat is played.
suphe.flavor: The blame stays with whoever sat at the table.

takdir.name: Share of Victory
takdir.text: Be a Minister when a Victory is played.

gozden.name: Sacrifice
gozden.flavor: Some give up their good name for the cause.

kulisci.name: Shuttle Diplomacy
kulisci.text: Place Intrigue cards on 3 different players.
kulisci.flavor: Ulus to Çankaya and back, every day.

yukselen.name: Two Cabinets
yukselen.flavor: One cabinet is luck; the second is skill.

itirazci.name: I Ask for the Floor
itirazci.flavor: "Mr Speaker, I ask for the floor!"

hedef.name: Talk of the Town
hedef.text: Have other players place 2 or more Intrigue cards on you in one crisis.
hedef.flavor: No paper goes to print without your name.

ortak.name: Stand Behind
ortak.text: Place a Vote of Confidence or a Surety on a Minister.
ortak.flavor: Whoever stands behind a man falls with him.

hazine.name: Mobilisation
hazine.text: Play 3 Intrigue cards in one crisis.
hazine.flavor: Everything you have, to the front.

koltuk.name: Through the Back Door
koltuk.text: Become a Minister through an Intrigue card.

kulak.name: Wiretap
kulak.text: Use Tail, Telegraph Office, Inquiry or Switchboard.
kulak.flavor: In Ankara every line has an ear.

yeniceri.name: The Irregulars' Mutiny
yeniceri.text: Players with 0 Standing draw 1 Intrigue card each.

hazine.name: National Levies
hazine.text: Nobody draws an Intrigue card this crisis.

venedik.name: Mission to Moscow
venedik.text: The two players beside the Gazi draw 1 Intrigue card each.

harem.name: Gossip at the Taşhan
harem.text: Least Standing draws 1 Intrigue card; on a tie, the Gazi picks.

macar.name: Sakarya
macar.text: Nobody draws an Intrigue card this crisis.
macar.flavor: "There is no line of defence, there is a surface of defence."

muhur.name: The London Agreements
muhur.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.

divan.name: The First Constitution
divan.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.

sehzade.name: The Candidate List
sehzade.text: The two players beside the Gazi draw 1 Intrigue card each.

istanbul.name: Spy Hunt
istanbul.text: Everyone except the Gazi draws 1 Intrigue card.

irakeyn.name: The Great Offensive
irakeyn.text: Least Standing draws 1 Intrigue card; on a tie, the Gazi picks.

isabella.name: Lausanne
isabella.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.
isabella.flavor: Eight months of bargaining; they left the table once, and came back.

h.name: Victory
text: Verdict: the Gazi gives a Minister 1 Standing.
h.flavor: The line is open and the news is good.

x.name: Defeat
text: Verdict: the Gazi takes 1 Standing from a Minister.
x.flavor: "Pasha, I swear I did all I could!"

loyalist.name: Patriot
text: You win when 4 Victories are on the Liberation track.

traitor.name: Traitor
text: You win when 5 Defeats are on the Occupation track.
traitor.flavor: The occupation has its men in Ankara too.

sorusturma.name: Interrogation
sorusturma.text: The Gazi names an interrogator, who secretly looks at one player's Allegiance card, then may say anything.

hazineDefteri.name: Intelligence Report
hazineDefteri.text: Before the next crisis, the Gazi names a player, who secretly looks at the top 3 Telegram cards.

fermanRefresh.name: Command Extended
fermanRefresh.text: The Gazi may use Commander-in-Chief again. He never holds more than one.

strings.tagline: There's a traitor in the Assembly.
strings.endTreason: The fifth {term.hiyanet} is played. The Assembly is dissolved.
strings.endLoyalty: The fourth {term.hizmet} is played. The Republic is proclaimed.
strings.pref.music.why: A quiet loop in the Dorian mode, in an uneven seven.
strings.lobby.shareText: Join my Entrika table; the Assembly is sitting. Room code: {code}
strings.err.exiled: Under {power.surgun}, this player can't be {term.minister:a} this {term.crisis}.
strings.log.surgun: {who} is held out by {power.surgun} this {term.crisis}: they can't be {term.minister:a}.
strings.lobby.learningWhy: Learning game: no {term.companion:pl}, {term.ambition:pl} or {term.favor} powers, and no foreign Figures dealt.
